newsitem.title: LATVIA: KAIJA IN PROFIT IN 1996, SEES 1.1 MLN LATS IN '97.
newsitem.headline: KAIJA IN PROFIT IN 1996, SEES 1.1 MLN LATS IN '97.

text.p: Fish cannery Kaija said on Tuesday that its audited 1996 net profit came to 639,893 lats against a loss of 200,615 lats in 1995 and that it expected a 1997 profit of 1.1 million lats.
Kaija also said in a statement that it expects 1997 income to be 14.4 million lats and expenses to be 13.3 million lats.

The management was also due to suggest to a shareholders meeting, taking place on Tuesday, to transfer 31,995 lats of 1996 profit into reserves and use the remaining 607,898 lats in the development of the company.
The company said its net turnover in 1996 was 11.4 million lats versus 3.89 million lats in 1995 and gross profit was 2.14 million lats versus 594,482 lats.
Its administrative expenses rose to 958,172 lats from 311,423 lats and its pre-tax profit was 315,363 lats versus a profit of 196,656 lats.
It said its staff numbers rose to 664 people from 576 people and the average wage was 148.2 lats versus 107.4 lats.
Its total output was worth 12.14 million lats versus 7.03 million lats.
